pr_body:
Fixes #22183
Replaces #22187

This PR adds secrets for users. I refactored the files for organizations and repos to use the same logic and templates. I splitted the secrets from deploy keys again and reverted the fix from #22187.
pr_comments: I merge deploy keys and secrets UI because too many Tab in repository setting and these two are very simple. And after actions merged, there will be actins Tab.

That's a clear sign for a failed design and the reason why Github and Gitlab use a vertical navigation. We already do this for the organization settings and should adopt it for the other settings too (user, repo, admin).
Generally speaking, I also prefer vertical navigation. I think even Gogs had that. Either that, or make the horizontal navs overflow into a "..." menu with JS.

The change looks like this:
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1666336/208897302-ce6496ce-37a1-417f-a0ba-4711d9a595db.png)

I don't think we are already at the "too many tabs" limit even if "Actions" get's added.
Looks fine if the repo nav overflows before it, even considering other languages.
Yes, they all share the same template. So all three lists are changed.

I can't find any more problems than those that have already been pointed out. 👍🏻

And there are some questions in my mind about secrets, I think it's a good place to post them:

1. Are secrets working for actions only? Of course it is now, and?
2. If yes, what's the point of displaying the secret setting when `Actions` is disabled? Someone who doesn't like `Actions` will say "I can't disable Actions completely because there's a secret setting which is useless to me".
3. Maybe we can't provide secrets for other CICD even if Actions is disabled, but is it really needed and safe?
4. Maybe `Secrets` and `Runners`(runners of Actions) can share one setting tab named "Actions", but that means we must agree Secrets is a part of Actions.

I saw @lunny comment in a issue he intended to use secrets for other places also, as LDAP bind DN password and such. Maybe other places of the code that store secrets (encrypted or not) could be refsctored to use this feature also. Examples:

* LDAP
* Webhooks
* Repository mirrors

I think that making this a one stop shop for all secrets, maybe it will be easier to, in the future, enhance it, by integrating with Hashicorp Vault, for example.

> I saw @lunny comment in an issue he intended to use secrets for other places also, as LDAP bind DN password and such. Maybe other places of the code that store secrets (encrypted or not) could be refsctored to use this feature also. Examples:
> 
> * LDAP
> * Webhooks
> * Repository mirrors
> 
> I think that making this a one stop shop for all secrets, maybe it will be easier to, in the future, enhance it, by integrating with Hashicorp Vault, for example.

Maybe we need to support some template variables like `${my_mirror_password}` in mirror configuration which `${my_mirror_password}` will be replaced from secrets when mirror executing. Anyhow, secrets will be heavily used by actions but some other places will also use it.
Okay, I already see that we need #22184 at some point…

issue_context.title: User secrets
issue_context.body:
Currently, we have both org- and repo secrets.
Some users already reported that they would like to have secrets that are shared across their own repos as well.
The code base should already allow that already, the only thing that needs to be added is a settings page to configure the user secrets.

_Originally posted by @KN4CK3R in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/22142#issuecomment-1352927219, but extracted into its own issue to get the PR merged_
comments:
> Currently, we have both org- and repo secrets

Is that a toggle-able feature? I don't see any secrets tab on repo/org on 1.19.
The secrets are in the settings of the repo/org.
Ah, I do see the tab on try.gitea.io, but not on my local instances, must be something in the config or db that's preventing the tabs from showing.

Are you sure you have that commit already on your instance?
Because it was only merged 36 hours ago, and I don't remember any config option in the PR…
Ah, I was out of date. Did miss that PR apparently.
